summary: Implemented show_speed in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default False), a static render_speed method, and speed rendering in render() for unknown totals. track() gained show_speed=True and passes it to the column. Progress.track now infers the total as explicit, else len() for Sized sequences, else None, without raising. CHANGELOG.md has the Unreleased/Added entry. tests/test_progress.py gained test_task_progress_column_speed and the two ValueError assertions were removed. Nothing was run: tests, mypy, and black are unverified.
